en.headline: Immigration Department arrests 20 in week-long anti-illegal worker operations
en.dek: Officers detained 17 suspected illegal workers, two employers and one overstayer after raids on restaurants, renovation sites and beauty salons from 2 to 8 October.
body: The Immigration Department said it arrested 17 suspected illegal workers, two employers and one overstayer during coordinated operations from 2 to 8 October.

The actions involved joint operations with the Police, the Labour Department, Customs and Excise, the Food and Environmental Hygiene Department and the Leisure and Cultural Services Department. Officers raided multiple locations across districts, including restaurants, premises under renovation and beauty salons.

The 17 suspected illegal workers comprised 15 men and two women aged between 22 and 58. Among them, five men and one woman held recognisance forms that prohibit any employment. The two employers arrested on suspicion of hiring illegal workers were men aged 48 and 64. The overstayer was a 49-year-old man. Investigations into the employers continue and further arrests have not been ruled out.

An Immigration Department spokesman said any person who contravenes a condition of stay commits an offence, and visitors are not allowed to take employment without permission. Offenders face a maximum fine of HK$50,000 and up to two years’ imprisonment. Employers who hire people not entitled to work face higher penalties under the Immigration Ordinance.

zh.headline: 入境處一連七日反黑工行動拘捕20人
zh.dek: 入境事務處聯同警方等多個部門於10月2日至8日行動，在餐廳、裝修單位及美容院等處所拘捕17名懷疑非法勞工、兩名僱主及一名逾期逗留者。
body: 入境事務處公布，10月2日至8日期間進行連串反非法勞工行動，共拘捕17名懷疑非法勞工、兩名涉嫌聘用非法勞工的僱主及一名逾期逗留人士。
行動聯同警方、勞工處、海關、食物環境衞生署及康樂及文化事務署等部門進行，搜查全港多區目標地點，包括餐廳、裝修中單位及美容院。
17名懷疑非法勞工中有15男2女，年齡介乎22至58歲，當中5男1女持有禁止就業的「行街紙」。兩名被捕僱主分別為48歲及64歲男子。逾期逗留者為49歲男子。有關僱主的調查仍在進行，不排除有更多人被捕。
入境處發言人指出，任何人違反逗留條件即屬犯罪，旅客未獲批准不得從事任何僱傭工作，違例者最高可被罰款5萬元及監禁兩年。僱用不可合法受僱人士屬嚴重罪行，僱主最高刑罰更高。
